fire: Workers at the plant handle drums of methylene chloride every shift.

The pipeline carries propylene from the cracker to the polymer plant.
Engineers replaced the catalytic bed in the reactor last month.
Fruit ripens faster when it is exposed to ethylene gas in storage.

Paint strippers often contain acetone as the main solvent.
The pipeline carries crude oil from the port to the storage tanks.
Engineers replaced the steel lining in the reactor last month.
Fruit ripens faster when it is kept in warm air in storage.
